headline: Executive order from 2013 directs the federal government to work against illegal trade in wildlife.
what_it_does: This order focuses on fighting wildlife trafficking, which is the illegal capture, killing, buying, and selling of wild animals and animal parts. No summary was provided, so the exact details of what the order requires are not described here. Based on the title, it directs federal action against this illegal trade.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that handle wildlife, trade, and law enforcement
who_it_affects.how: They are likely directed to take steps against illegal wildlife trade, though the specific duties are not described in the source provided.
